games.name: Playbreak
games.desc:
This is a 1v6 asymmetrical game heavily inspired by "Project: Playtime", but with a few additions and improvements of its own, aiming to become more original over time.
Please note that this game is in BETA, nothing is final, and it should not be treated as such.
If you love the game, it'll get even better, we are currently working on the FULL release!
The entire game will be recoded, new mechanics will come, and much more!
- HOW TO PLAY -
Specialists must complete puzzles, collect toy parts, and help each other escape.
The monster must try to stop the Specialists from completing their tasks by downing them and throwing them into the feeding pit.

- IMPORTANT -
All rights belong to Mob Entertainment for their respective items, models, rigs, characters, sounds, music, and animations. I do not own them. Please support Mob Entertainment before anything else.
If you have any copyright concerns, feel free to message me, and I will gladly remove any content from the game as soon as possible.

games.name: Steel Titans
games.desc:
Steel Titans is one of the most realistic and historically accurate tank games on Roblox with over 160 tanks to choose from!


Controls:
WASD- move
Left click- Fire
Right click- Scope view
123- Change selected ammo for primary gun
456- change selected ammo for secondary gun
Space- Fire secondary gun(s)
E- spot
Q- binoculars
Tab- view score menu
X- X-ray to view modules
C- Turret lock
V- change view
T- toggle special action

games.name: Indo Voice
games.desc:
Welcome to Indo Voice!

Enter a colorful social world where your voice is the center of attention! Indo Voice is our 4th creation, continuing a long tradition of delivering the best social experience. As the pioneer of hangout games in Indonesia since 2014, we have dedicated more than a decade to perfecting the art of play and socialization.

💖 Features & Activities:
- Connect - Meet and chat with friends from all over Indonesia! 🇮🇩
- Voice Chat - Real-time chat for a more realistic experience! 🗣️
- Appreciate - Give & Receive Hearts to share a positive aura!
- Express - Share stories, jokes, or sing your favorite song! 🎶
- Fish & Play - Be on the edge while fishing or playing mini-games! 🎣🎮
- Customize - Look different with exclusive Aura, Trail, Pet, and Tools! ✨
- Vibe - Show off your style with a variety of dance emotes and movements! 🕺

games.name: Blood and Iron
games.desc:
Experience the thunder of cannons, the clash of steel, and the roar of drums as you fight for glory in the legendary Napoleonic Wars. Choose your nation and regiment – from the iconic French Old Guard, to the elite British 95th Rifles. The ability to rewrite history is in your hands!

Featuring:
- 13 nations from across Europe
- Over 35 historical and fictional battles
- 15 different classes, from line infantry to artillery
- More than 300 regiments to pick from

Recent changes:
- Fix characters only using the default Roblox face

Playing in first person is highly recommended.

games.name: Superforest [🍉]
games.desc:
🌱💚✨ Play. Grow. Reforest the World! ✨💚🌳

Welcome to Superforest!  Build the forest of your dreams with friends! A magical forest-building adventure awaits.

What you do:

🧱 Build your forest. Buy and place soil tiles, create your perfect forest layout.
🌱 Plant magical trees. Plant seeds, grow trees over time, and unlock rarer species as your forest expands.
🍒 Harvest and earn. Collect orbs, harvest fruits, sell at the market, and reinvest to grow faster, bigger, and rarer.
🧬 Find mutations. Harvests mutate during weather changes & magical events
🐾 Collect pets. Unlock powerful companions to help your forest grow.

Work together and boost growth and harvest for everyone:
✨ Contribute potions into the Spirit Well to trigger a magical Time Surge! 
🌳 Offer harvest to the Mother Tree shrine to stoke the enchanted fire!
🧙 Witching hour happens every night, defend your forest from thieves or share your bounty, the choice is yours!

🔄 Superforest is in beta and active development.
